verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own MCP server supports Guides: markdown documents that capture an org's metric definitions, join conventions, and domain context so agents produce accurate SQL. This is a first-party way to declare metrics and joins once for AI tools, but it is unstructured prompt context, not a governed semantic model that SQL queries and BI tools resolve against. The dbt-duckdb adapter is a third-party transformation integration and earns no credit toward a semantic layer. Missing for 10: a structured metric/dimension/join model, enforcement so regular SQL and BI queries answer consistently against it, governance controls over the definitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
